roku_app_id.label: Roku app IDs
roku_app_id.description: Comma-separated IDs of the Roku apps that play Music Assistant's streams, in order of preference. Playback goes to a listed app that is already open on the Roku, or else starts the first listed app installed on it. By default: Media Assistant from the Roku Channel Store (782875), then Mass TV from the Roku Channel Store (883989). If you sideloaded the App on your Roku, add ID "dev" to this list.

auto_scan.label: Allow automatic Roku discovery
auto_scan.description: Enable automatic discovery of Roku players.

manifest.description: Support for Roku's running Media Assistant.
